title: Identify an electron-deficient species
statement:
Which central atom has six electrons in the customary single-bond Lewis structure?

[_]{a}

explanations: Three single bonds give six electrons.
Three bonds and one lone pair give eight.

hints: Count pairs around the center only.
H follows a duet and is peripheral in the listed examples.
A central boron with three bonds has six electrons.
solution: Count pairs around the center only. H follows a duet and is peripheral in the listed examples. A central boron with three bonds has six electrons. Three single bonds give six electrons.
